title: Longest Lyndon substring

problem.name: Longest Lyndon substring
problem.statement_latex: Given $S\in\Sigma^n$ over an ordered alphabet, find its longest substring that is strictly lexicographically smaller than every nontrivial cyclic rotation of itself. Complexity uses indexed characters.
